text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — inference-runtime error-rate spike in us-west-2 (service: inference-runtime). Triggered at 2045126789. Paging oncall now.

alex: Taking this — I'm oncall. Acknowledge. Any customer-facing impact known?

sam: Seeing elevated 5xxs on the runtime LB, looks like KV cache misses + backend timeouts. Collecting logs now.

maria: Heads-up: CS queue already called — 2 customers pinged us about higher error rates in last 10m. We should prep a status page entry asap.

alex: Reproducing a few failed requests locally against canary gateway, error is `503 downstream timeout`. Pushing a diagnostic trace to #eng-runtime.

sam: Snapshot of recent errors (cut):
```
[2045126786] svc=runtime host=rt-03 err=rpc: timeout deadline exceeded
[2045126791] svc=runtime host=rt-02 err=kvcache: miss then backend timeout
[2045126797] svc=runtime host=rt-03 err=memcpy: out_of_bounds? (investigating)
```

priya: I'm next on the overnight handoff at 2045126900. If this isn't resolved before then I'll take over. Keep me in the loop with mitigation steps.

jordan: Suggestion: flip traffic to fallback model-compat pool (model-v1-compat) to reduce backend pressure while we triage. That should be transparent to most customers.

alex: Agree. Sam, can you prepare a short rollback/route override? devops-bot, can we do a temporary route to model-v1-compat for us-west-2?

devops-bot: @alex route-override job queued: `override-route us-west-2 -> model-v1-compat` (job id: r-2045126799). ETA ~30s.

sam: Route override applied. Monitoring error rate and latency now.

alex: Error rate dropped from ~12% to ~1.8% after override. Good. Maria, can you draft a brief status page update + customer notification? Keep it concise: impact, mitigation, ETA for RCA.

maria: Drafting — propose this status page copy:
```
Summary: Intermittent inference errors for requests served from us-west-2.
Impact: ~10–12% of API requests returned 5xx between 2045126786 and 2045126860; we routed traffic to a compatible fallback to restore service.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to model-v1-compat; engineers are investigating root cause.
Next updates: We will post an RCA timeline within 48 hours.
```

alex: Slight edit: include affected customers note: "Some customers using Dedicated us-west-2 pools may have experienced degraded responses." Otherwise LGTM.

maria: Updated and publishing to status page now. Also preparing a short CS blurb to send to impacted customers — will post for review.

sam: Quick root-cause notes so far: autoscaler spun additional pods but a recent runtime kernel change (merged yesterday) exposed a path where KV cache eviction + concurrent memcopy can cause transient segfaults leading to timeouts. We're reproducing in staging with the same kernel flags.

alex: If segfaults are involved, we should capture core dumps and disable the suspect kernel flag in staging to validate. Sam, prioritize capturing core dumps from rt-02 and rt-03.

sam: On it. Commands I'm running:
```bash
kubectl exec -it rt-03 -- sudo gcore -o /tmp/core_rt-03 $(pidof runtime_process)
aws s3 cp /tmp/core_rt-03 s3://redwood-dumps/2045126789/
```

priya: Taking over oncall at 2045126900 — pairing with Alex for handoff. Alex, give me the short checklist for continuity.

alex: Handoff checklist to Priya:
- Route override to model-v1-compat (active)
- Core dumps uploaded to s3://redwood-dumps/2045126789/
- Error rates down to ~1–2% — monitor for 15m
- CS status page posted (link in #status)
- Follow-up: engineering RCA to be authored by Sam; include timeline + corrective actions

priya: Got it. I'll monitor for the next hour and coordinate with Sam for any rollback to canary if needed.

(devops-bot): Route override r-2045126799 showing stable for 20m, no automated rollback triggered.

alex: Core dumps show a memcopy race in the kernel path tied to the new optimization flag. Sam, can you prepare a PR to revert that optimization and run a canary?

sam: Preparing PR now: `revert: disable-fast-memcopy-optimizer` — will run canary in staging and then prepare for a controlled deploy to us-west-2. ETA 2 hours.

maria: CS question for the customer-facing RCA: they want an explicit timeline (when we first saw errors, when mitigation applied, when full service restored) and concrete next steps to prevent recurrence. I'll need exact timestamps.

alex: Timeline (precise):
- 2045126786: first elevated error observed by monitoring
- 2045126792: automatic pager triggered
- 2045126799: route override job queued
- 2045126805: route override applied (traffic shifted)
- 2045126825: error rate dropped under 2%
- 2045126898: core dumps uploaded for analysis
- 2045127005: revert PR merged to canary
- 2045127018: canary stable, roll to us-west-2 started
- 2045127022: full traffic on reverted build, service latency normal

jordan: For the RCA root cause statement I propose: "A recently merged runtime optimization interacted with autoscaler-triggered concurrent operations causing KV cache eviction races and transient memcopy faults. Under load, this manifested as increased 5xxs until we routed traffic to a compatible pool and reverted the optimization." Thoughts?

sam: Accurate. Also add "lack of pre-merge perf/regression test for kernel-flag interactions" as a contributing factor.

maria: Drafting the customer-facing RCA summary now. Here's the short summary for review:
```
What happened: Between 2045126786 and 2045127022, some requests to the inference runtime in us-west-2 returned errors due to a runtime optimization that caused cache eviction races under scale.
What we did: We temporarily routed traffic to a compatible model pool to restore service, captured diagnostics, and reverted the optimization after validating it in canary.
Impact: ~10–12% of requests for a subset of customers in us-west-2 experienced 5xx responses. No data loss.
Preventative actions: revert optimization (done), add regression tests for kernel-flag interactions, tighten autoscaler cooldowns, add circuit-breaker fallback for future memcopy faults.
```

alex: Add assigned owners for each preventive action and timelines:
- revert optimization: sam — completed 2045127005
- regression tests: eng-ml (jordan) — 2 weeks
- autoscaler cooldown tuning: eng-platform (alex/priya) — 1 week
- circuit-breaker fallback: eng-runtime (sam) — 3 weeks

maria: Updated. Also tagging legal and security for the "no data loss" statement to confirm.

devops-bot: Incident status: CLOSED. Root cause: runtime optimization + autoscaler interaction -> KV eviction race. Incident reference: INC-2045126789.

maria: Final ask — one customer wants a slightly expanded timeline showing minute-level timestamps in their local timezone. Alex/Sam, can you export a sanitized timeline with UTC -> PST conversion? I'll attach to the customer email.

alex: I'll produce the sanitized timeline and drop into the CS draft by EOD. Sam, can you sign off on the technical sections before we send?

sam: I'll review in 30m and add any missing technical caveats.

priya: Logging an internal follow-up doc and scheduling a 1hr postmortem next week (invite to eng-runtime, eng-platform, cs). I'll own the calendar.

maria: Thanks all. Draft customer email will be posted in this thread for final approval before send. :handshake:
